settings.text: Upholstered by hand, one bed at a time

settings.heading: We started because our own bed broke
settings.text: Two years, one collapsed slat and a customer service line that never picked up. We could not find a bed under £1,500 that was built properly and delivered by people who cared, so we made one. Everything since has been an argument with that first experience.

settings.title: Designed here
settings.text: Every frame is drawn in-house, then prototyped and slept on before it goes near the site.

settings.title: Made in Yorkshire
settings.text: Cut, joined and upholstered by a workshop we have used since day one.

settings.title: Delivered built
settings.text: Two of our own team carry it up, assemble it and take the packaging with them.

settings.title: Backed for a decade
settings.text: Ten years on the frame. If it fails in normal use, we fix or replace it.

settings.heading: Four things we refuse to cut

settings.headline: Worth the wait
settings.quote: Three weeks for a made-to-order bed felt long until it arrived. The finish is closer to furniture than to anything we saw on the high street.
settings.author: Elena K.

settings.headline: Second one we've bought
settings.quote: Bought for the spare room after living with ours for two years. Same quality, same delivery team, no hesitation.
settings.author: Tom B.

settings.headline: They answered on a Sunday
settings.quote: Asked a question about stair access at 9pm on a Sunday and had a proper answer within the hour. That is unusual.
settings.author: Sarah D.

settings.heading: What people say once they've lived with it
Ten years on every frame
settings.text: If the frame or the gas-lift mechanism fails in normal use within ten years, we repair or replace it free of charge. No forms, no fight.
